# Which New Cricut StickerPix™ Machine Is Right for You?


-
-
-


29 September 2026


[Cricut](https://cricut.com/blog/author/cricut/)


---


Easily bring your camera roll to life with our all-new Cricut StickerPix™ machines. Create custom, pro-quality stickers, labels, photo prints, cards, and invitations — at home, in minutes. Not sure which one is for you? Keep reading to find your perfect fit.


## Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut™ vs. Cricut StickerPix Print™ at a Glance


Machine Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut Cricut StickerPix Print


Size 8 in x 11.3 in x 4.1 in 7.8 in x 5 in x 3.5 in


Weight 6.6 lbs 2.3 lb


Prints and laminates Yes Yes


Cuts Yes No


Compatible materials Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut Photo Paper and Sticker Sheets Cricut StickerPix Print Photo Paper and Pre-cut Sticker Sheets


Colors Sea Green, Powder Blue Sea Green, Blue


Connectivity Bluetooth® Wi-Fi


Best for People who want to make custom-cut stickers and labels in any shape, plus photo prints, and more People who want to make pre-cut stickers and labels in a variety of shapes, plus photo prints, and more


### Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut


Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut is our all-in-one sticker and photo printer and cutter. It prints, laminates, and cuts in one step to create custom-cut stickers and labels, plus photo prints, cards, and invites. Available in Powder Blue and Sea Green, it measures 8 in x 11.3 in x 4.1 in. The machine is compatible with 4 in x 7 in Sticker Sheets and 4 in x 6 in Photo Paper.


### Cricut StickerPix Print


Cricut StickerPix Print is our all-in-one sticker and photo printer. Instead of precision-cutting stickers and labels into custom shapes, it uses pre-cut sticker sheets available in a variety of shapes. Plus, the pre-cut sticker sheets simplify sizing, arrangement, and more. Available in Blue and Sea Green, its smaller footprint measures 7.8 in x 5 in x 3.5 in. This machine is compatible with 4 in x 6 in Pre-cut Sticker Sheets and 4 in x 6 in Photo Paper.


## What is the difference between Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut and Cricut StickerPix Print?


The main difference between Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut and Cricut StickerPix Print is that Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut can cut custom shapes for your stickers, whereas Cricut StickerPix Print cannot cut. Cricut StickerPix only prints and laminates; it uses pre-cut sticker sheets to create custom stickers.


Plus, Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut has a larger footprint, measuring at 8 in x 11.3 in x 4.1 in versus Cricut StickerPix Print’s 7.8 in x 5 in x 3.5 in size.


## What are the similarities between Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut and Cricut StickerPix Print?


### Printing and laminating


Both Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut and Cricut StickerPix Print print and laminate. You can also use either machine to make custom stickers, photo prints, cards, invitations, and labels — with the same pro-quality, water-, scratch-, and fade-resistant results.


### Dye-sub technology


Both machines use dye-sublimation technology, which uses heat to transfer dye directly onto the material instead of spraying on ink droplets like traditional printers. The result is smooth, continuous color that’s especially well suited to photos.


### Design Space software


The machines also work with the same software, Design Space®, including one-click transformations, editable templates, and powerful editing tools like Background Remover.*


## What materials do Cricut StickerPix™ machines use?


Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut is compatible with 4 in x 7 in Sticker Sheets and 4 in x 6 in Photo Paper.


Cricut StickerPix Print is compatible with 4 in x 6 in Pre-cut Sticker Sheet in a variety of shapes, as well as 4 in x 6 in Photo Paper.


Both machines are compatible with their own unique ink cartridge. These cartridges are not interchangeable.


## Which sticker machine should I choose?


If you want more flexibility to create stickers and labels in custom shapes — and a machine that prints, laminates, and cuts — Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut is your perfect fit.


If you don’t need custom shapes and want a more compact machine for making pre-cut stickers and labels, plus photo prints, and more, Cricut StickerPix Print is the machine for you.


See both machines in action and pick the best one for you on[cricut.com](https://cricut.com/en-us/discover-sticker-machines) .

*Certain software features require paid subscription. See cricut.com for terms and details.

The printer heats a ribbon of colored dye and transfers it into the coated surface of the material one color at a time, then finishes with a clear protective layer. Because the dye becomes part of the material, prints are smooth and durable.

####


Pre-cut stickers come in set shapes already cut into the sheet. Custom-shape stickers are cut to whatever outline your design has. Kiss-cut means only the sticker is cut and the backing stays intact, so it peels easily while die-cut means the sticker and its backing are both cut through. Cricut StickerPix machines only print on Pre-cut Sticker Sheets (Cricut StickerPix Print) or kiss-cut on Sticker Sheets (Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut).


####


Cricut StickerPix machines laminate your stickers as they print, making them water-, scratch-, and fade- resistant.


####


While you can make labels using Cricut StickerPix machines, they are not technically label printers. They are sticker machines.


Label printers are built for text — shipping labels, barcodes, and organization — and usually print in one or two colors on plain label stock. Sticker machines print full-color photos and designs and have an adhesive backing.

Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut is only compatible with Cricut StickerPix Print + Cut Photo Paper and Sticker Sheets. The ink cartridges are only compatible with their specific machine. Neither materials nor ink cartridges for the Cricut StickerPix machines are cross-compatible.
